Hannah / Laura / Sally — attached is our response matrix (Redwood_Response_Matrix.xlsx) and a proposed order form draft (draft_order_form_v2.pdf) with inline comments. Summary of position and rationale below (keeps the thread focused for procurement):

1) IP & Data:
- Redwood’s baseline: Redwood retains ownership of the service and model IP (including improvements to model weights and model code).
- Customer content: Orion retains ownership of its Customer Data and any outputs that are purely Customer Data. For model-generated outputs, we grant Orion a perpetual, non-exclusive, sublicensable (for internal use) license to use outputs for its business purposes.
- Derivatives & training: Redwood will not claim ownership of customer-owned prompts or proprietary data. Redwood will not use identifiable customer data to retrain models without explicit agreement (offer: include narrow carve-out for anonymized telemetry for service improvement).

2) Indemnity:
- Redwood will indemnify for third-party claims to the extent those claims arise from Redwood’s gross negligence or willful misconduct, and for IP infringement claims resulting from Redwood’s modifications to third-party base-model code.
- We cannot accept broad customer-triggered indemnity for uses of customer prompts that embed third-party IP (customer-controlled inputs). We propose a reciprocal, limited IP indemnity: Redwood indemnifies claims arising from our service or model as delivered; Orion indemnifies for claims tied to customer-supplied content.

3) Liability cap & exceptions:
- Standard cap: liability limited to the greater of (i) actual direct damages up to two (2)x annualized fees paid under the order, or (ii) $1,000,000.
- Exceptions: no cap for gross negligence, willful misconduct, or breach of confidentiality regarding customer-provided sensitive data (PHI/PII).
- Rationale: 2x is our balancing point for most mid-market customers; 3x is possible for enterprise but requires underwriting and an SLA/insurance confirmation.

4) Order form items / SLA:
- Proposed SLA: 99.9% monthly availability for API endpoints in the agreed region; credits structured by request success rate (detailed in draft_order_form_v2.pdf).
- Termination: standard termination-for-cause + 90-day termination-for-convenience with pro-rata refunds for prepaid credits. We can consider shorter notice in exchange for higher minimum commitment.

5) Evidence & compliance:
- Will provide SOC 2 Type II report and current insurance certificate on request (we will push updated copies to you once the contract is at redline stage).

Action items: Marcus to include tracked redlines (attached), Hannah to confirm whether Orion will agree to 2x cap pending insurance, Laura to confirm SLA observability commitments.

Attachment(s): Redwood_Response_Matrix.xlsx; draft_order_form_v2.pdf
